# identity.CreateDeviceActivationInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Creates a one-time device activation code (core.device.create).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.CreateDeviceActivationInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.device.create` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | yes | `none` | Name of the device to activate. |  |
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node the device will be granted at. |  |
| `roles` | yes | `none` | Roles of the device grant (no escalation). |  |

_None._
